text: Timing of create moves 1-3% between builds whose merge_sort machine code is byte-identical (seen at dc7dd45 and 4fbfbad on the 50 MB synthetic input). Building with -C llvm-args=-align-all-functions=12 brings the builds within ±0.4%, so the swing is code placement. Treat a create delta under ~3% as noise unless instruction counts move too. Details on sufr-8073a8.
